# Flyover Con

> The Midwest's conference for screen printers and decorators. Hosted by P&M Apparel, Polk City, Iowa. FOC27 is presented by SanMar.

Flyover Con is a hands-on conference for Midwest screen printers and decorators, hosted inside P&M Apparel's working production facility. A modest registration fee keeps it accessible while sponsors cover the rest. No vendor booths, no sales pitches. Real shop-floor learning from people who run print and embroidery shops every day.

Most recent event: FOC26, April 17-18, 2026, in Polk City, Iowa. 16 sessions across two days, 19 speakers, hosted on the P&M Apparel shop floor.

FOC27 is confirmed for April 16 and 17, 2027, at the same location, capped at 75 attendees. FOC27 is presented by SanMar. Schedule and speakers are not yet announced as of September 2026. Silver ($1,000) and Gold ($2,500) sponsorships are open; the Presenting level is claimed. Commitments are requested by January 15, 2027. The call for speakers is open and proposals close November 13, 2026.
